sources.entry: Letterfork - AI rewrites a newsletter into 7 platform-native social posts (LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Substack Notes, Threads, Instagram, Reddit) in your own writing voice. Voice cloning learns from your past writing; no auto-publishing.

summary.name: Letterfork
summary.one_liner: Letterfork is an AI tool that rewrites one newsletter issue into seven platform-native social media posts in the author's own voice.
use_cases: Turning a weekly newsletter into social posts for several platforms
Reducing time spent repurposing long-form writing
Promoting a Substack or newsletter on LinkedIn, X, and Threads
Drafting platform-specific posts without a virtual assistant
Keeping a consistent personal writing voice across social channels
summary.what_it_does: Letterfork takes one newsletter issue and generates seven social media posts tailored to LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Substack Notes, Threads, Instagram, and Reddit. It is described as learning from the user's past writing to match their voice. The listing states it does not auto-publish, so posts are drafted for the user to review and share. The page's text is mostly a problem statement from the creator about the time cost of repurposing newsletter content, so details beyond these points are not confirmed on the page.
notable: Generates seven platform-native posts from a single newsletter issue
Voice cloning learns from the user's past writing
Free tier covers 3 rewrites with no credit card required
caveats: Free tier is limited to 3 rewrites; further use implies paid plans, whose pricing is not shown in the page text
Does not auto-publish, so posts must be shared manually
